tasks.title: Ingesta y recorte de los 4 GeoTIFF NISAR (F01)
tasks.desc: pipeline lee HH/HV t1/t2 desde data/raw, verifica CRS/rejilla/forma comunes, recorta al AOI del perímetro con margen y genera case.json. Hecho = comando reproducible + test con ráster sintético.

notes.text:
Refined spec agreed with David (2026-11-14). Supersedes the description where they differ.

Scope: ingest and crop the 4 NISAR GCOV power GeoTIFFs (HH/HV x t1/t2). No dB conversion or valid mask (that is DT-02).

- Inputs: config file with paths (data/raw/nisar/, gitignored) and expected granule IDs (t1 G4284560161-ASF, t2 G4340499432-ASF); record sha256 of every input.
- Grid check: all 4 inputs share CRS, transform and shape; any mismatch fails with a clear error.
- AOI: WFIGS 58728 perimeter bbox + 2 km margin, buffered in EPSG:32610 metres. Fail clearly if the AOI exceeds the raster extent.
- Crop: integer pixel window snapped to the native 10 m grid, no resampling, original nodata preserved. Windowed reads only (inputs ~3 GB each).
- Metadata: inspect the .h5 first (gamma0/RTC, real nodata, product mask); record findings in Engram; flag any contract impact.
- Outputs: data/interim/nisar/{t1,t2}_{hh,hv}.tif (float32) + data/interim/nisar/ingest.json (epochs, acquisition, AOI in 32610 and 4326, grid, checksums).
- case.json is NOT produced here: DT-04 assembles it from DT-01 + DT-03 + CH-01 (it needs method and reference).

Done = reproducible command (uv run python -m pipeline.ingest --config ...), deterministic outputs; synthetic-raster tests for matching grids, CRS/transform/shape mismatch, AOI outside raster, window alignment and nodata preservation; ruff + pytest green locally and in CI; PR carries real-run evidence (crop size, bbox, checksums), no data committed.

Plan: Opus subagent implements pipeline/ingest.py (config, grid check, AOI bbox+2km in 32610, snapped window crop, ingest.json) with synthetic tests in worktree feat/DT-01-nisar-ingest; separate review afterwards.

Implemented on feat/DT-01-nisar-ingest (ac53c9a, 3bf1e6f; not pushed). pipeline/ingest.py + example TOML config + 22 synthetic tests; scripts/check.py and contract validation pass (29 tests). Real run on the Plaskett pair: source grid 34992x34416 @10 m EPSG:32610; crop 1915x1624 px, snapped bounds (636000, 3967750, 655150, 3983990); outputs byte-identical over 3 runs. .h5 (t2): gamma0 RTC linear power, NaN nodata, no contract impact. Open: DT-02's 1,948,374 valid-pixel target does not match this crop (all 3,109,960 px valid). Pending: independent review (sol6.1 requested; T3 delegation unavailable this session).

Review by Codex gpt-6.1-sol (medium): changes requested, 4 findings, all fixed in 256f357. P1 output paths could alias inputs (now refused before any write; inputs hashed first). P2 config could change the analysis grid (now fixed to EPSG:32610 / 10 m). P2 AI attribution trailers removed from the unpublished commits (now 23977a1, 4e1a566). P3 corrupt inputs now give 'ingest error' with exit 2. 33 tests pass; ruff, scripts/check.py, contract validation and git diff --check pass. Real Plaskett re-run: outputs and ingest.json byte-identical to the previous run (crop 1915x1624). Not pushed; local backup branch backup/DT-01-pre-trailer-strip.

tasks.title: Conversión a dB y máscara de válidos
tasks.desc:
Convert the DT-01 crops to dB and build the common valid mask.
- Input: data/interim/nisar/*.tif + ingest.json (DT-01); verify input sha256 values match those recorded there.
- dB: 10*log10(x) only for finite x > 0; everything else becomes NaN. float32, same grid (EPSG:32610, 10 m, no resampling).
- Mask: valid_mask.tif uint8, 1 where all 4 inputs are finite, > 0 and not nodata; 0 otherwise.
- Outputs: data/interim/sar/{t1,t2}_{hh,hv}_db.tif + valid_mask.tif as COGs (rio-cogeo), plus sar.json with per-layer counts (valid, zero/negative, nodata), total valid pixels, % of the crop and checksums.
- Interface: document the COG layout (names, nodata, dtype) for EV-01 and get L3 review.
- Out of scope: stats.json (CH-02/DT-04) and the change index (CH-01).
Done = known-value tests (1 -> 0 dB, 0.1 -> -10 dB; 0, negative, NaN and nodata -> invalid); mask is the AND of the 4 layers; COGs pass validation; deterministic output; ruff + pytest green; PR carries real-run counts. The proposal's 1,948,374 figure (another 1539x1266 rectangle, 100% valid) is not an acceptance target.

notes.text: Agreed with David: concrete dB/mask spec; 1,948,374 target dropped (different crop, 100% valid, not testable); stats.json moved to CH-02/DT-04.

Explicitly authorized by David before approval (task still proposed). Implemented on feat/DT-02-db-valid-mask (18b838b, ddad3d4; not pushed): pipeline/sar.py + 23 synthetic tests (56 total), layout documented in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Codex gpt-6.1-sol (medium) review: changes requested (P2 non-atomic publication on failed reruns, P3 malformed ingest.json uncaught); both fixed in ddad3d4 with regression tests; reviewer confirmed cog_translate preserves values/grid exactly. Real Plaskett run: 3,109,960/3,109,960 valid (100%), no zero/negative/nodata pixels; median dB t1/t2 HH -8.6/-9.2, HV -13.4/-14.5; byte-identical reruns. Pending: L3 review of the COG layout for EV-01. Known pre-existing issue on main: scripts/check.py fails on Windows (python3/npm via subprocess).

Branch feat/DT-02-db-valid-mask pushed (18b838b, ddad3d4). dB COGs + valid_mask + sar.json; Codex review findings fixed; 56 tests green; real run 100% valid, byte-identical reruns. Ready for PR and L3 review of the COG layout.
